name.tc: 更換法定代表人（中國內地）
name.sc: 更换法定代表人（中国内地）

description: Change the legal representative of a PRC company and register it with the market regulator.
whenToUse: A company incorporated in Mainland China (WFOE, LLC) wants a new legal representative (法定代表人).
forms: Change registration application (变更登记申请书)

deadline.rule: Apply for change registration within 30 days after the decision (Market Entity Registration Regulations art. 24)

steps.label: Collect decision and new legal representative details
Prepare shareholder decision and filing pack
Submit on the market regulator (SAMR/AMR) portal
steps.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (local AMR)

steps.label: Confirm to client, reminding them to update the company chop, bank and tax records

documents.name: Shareholder decision: change of legal representative

complianceNotes: Under the 2024 Company Law (art. 10), the legal representative must be a director or manager who executes company affairs.
If the legal representative resigns, a new one must be appointed within 30 days.
Apply for change registration within 30 days after the decision; the business licence is re-issued.
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.

name.tc: 更換董事、監事或經理（中國內地）
name.sc: 更换董事、监事或经理（中国内地）

description: Change directors, supervisors or the general manager of a PRC company and file the change.
whenToUse: A Mainland China company changes a director (执行董事/董事), supervisor (监事) or general manager (经理).

deadline.rule: File within 30 days after the change

steps.label: Submit on the market regulator (SAMR/AMR) portal
steps.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (local AMR)

complianceNotes: A company with fewer shareholders may have one director and one supervisor, or an audit committee instead of supervisors (2024 Company Law arts. 75, 83).
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.

description: Change the registered address (住所) of a PRC company.
whenToUse: A Mainland China company is moving its registered address.

deadline.rule: Apply within 30 days after the decision

steps.label: Collect the new address and lease
Submit on the market regulator (SAMR/AMR) portal
steps.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (local AMR)

steps.label: Confirm to client, reminding them to update tax registration

documents.name: Shareholder decision: change of registered address

complianceNotes: Moving across districts may need the new district regulator’s acceptance first.
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.

name.tc: 變更註冊資本（中國內地）
name.sc: 变更注册资本（中国内地）

description: Increase or reduce registered capital, or adjust subscription deadlines to meet the 2024 Company Law five-year rule.
whenToUse: A Mainland China company wants to increase or reduce registered capital, or must shorten capital contribution deadlines.

deadline.rule: Apply within 30 days after the decision; a reduction also needs a public notice to creditors

steps.label: Prepare shareholder decision and amended articles
Submit on the market regulator (SAMR/AMR) portal
steps.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (local AMR)

documents.name: Shareholder decision: change of registered capital

complianceNotes: LLC shareholders must pay subscribed capital within 5 years of establishment (2024 Company Law art. 47).
Companies established before 1 July 2024 with longer contribution periods must adjust them during the transition period ending 30 June 2027 so that capital is paid by 30 June 2032.
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.

description: Transfer equity in a PRC LLC and register the change of shareholder.
whenToUse: A shareholder of a Mainland China company is transferring some or all of its equity.
forms: Change registration application; equity transfer agreement

deadline.rule: Apply within 30 days after the transfer

steps.label: Prepare transfer agreement and shareholder decision
Submit on the market regulator (SAMR/AMR) portal
steps.authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (local AMR)

steps.label: Confirm to client, noting tax filings on the transfer

complianceNotes: Other shareholders have a pre-emption right on transfers to third parties unless the articles say otherwise (2024 Company Law art. 84).
Transfer of equity by a non-resident may trigger PRC withholding tax; involve the tax adviser.
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.

description: File the annual report on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.
whenToUse: The annual report of a Mainland China company is due, or the client asks about it.

deadline.rule: 1 January to 30 June each year, for the previous year

steps.label: Submit on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
steps.authority: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System

complianceNotes: Late or missing annual reports lead to listing in the abnormal operations list.
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.

name.tc: 受益所有人備案（中國內地）
name.sc: 受益所有人备案（中国内地）

description: File or update beneficial owner information under the PBOC/SAMR rules effective 1 November 2024.
whenToUse: A Mainland China company needs to file or update its beneficial owners.

deadline.rule: Update within 30 days after a change

complianceNotes: Existing entities had until 1 November 2025 to complete their first filing.
verifyNote: Summarised from secondary sources for CN; verify with a qualified local company secretary or agent before relying on it.
